author: Iron
body: I think that this is something worth trialling. I suggest that the mapdevelopers form a "live team." Basically what the people will do is focus on making hubs festive or make them represent current events. Obviously not everyday, but maybe every week just like google does with their logo. I also suggest that these people organize map tournaments and more. So basically 1/2=Maps 1/2=Hubs and Events.

replies.body: Shouldn't this just be an inherent part of the group's tasks? Making weekly themed hubs might be a bit excessive, although upgrades to the hub every week would be cool...
